args.body: Advance the existing CATALOGUE-BUYER-EXAMPLE-PLACEMENT mission under a valid lease. Use TASK-179585850100 and the committed timed-delivery rehearsal to verify the existing EN/FR worked example. Reuse the existing staged example if it reports the two fictional discrepancies, explains how their locations were confirmed by SKU, and distinguishes produced-row comparison from input-only validation. Apply only the supported example to the release candidate, preserving the actual inquiry route and offer terms. Verify the candidate against the served baseline and existing release inventory. Obtain a host dry-run digest and hand it to an eligible independent reviewer. If an equivalent candidate is already staged, move it directly to that handoff. If already approved, publish only in an eligible turn through the host gate and verify the served bytes. Read back the applicable evidence before closing with a lesson. Keep the price provisional and treat the rehearsal as fictional.

description: The catalogue rehearsal reproduced two discrepancies and located both by SKU. That gives buyers a concrete example of the report they could request. Advance the existing placement mission using that evidence and keep CAD 60 provisional. Commercial feedback is available as interpreted signals, with zero classified events and five unclassified sources, so attributable demand remains unknown. Treasury is unfunded and has no verified revenue. Placement can proceed through staging and independent review without spending. Any order still requires administrative acceptance, and settlement requires separate verification.
